service_mechanism_washing_body:
Lavanderia has partnered with a number of professional laundry factories and built a strict quality control system called "123", applying "365" service standards along with sorting, washing, ironing, sterilizing, drying and packaging, to guarantee the cleaning quality of every garment.

Lavanderia also regularly evaluates its partner laundry factories to ensure the quality and cleanliness of the clothes delivered to customers.
service_mechanism_delivery_body:
Lavanderia employs delivery staff in every residential community to work as pickup and delivery agents, responsible for serving users within 2 km of their area.

After a customer places an order, the delivery agent, wearing the company's blue uniform, arrives at the customer's home on time to collect the clothes.

Washed clothes are delivered within 72 hours at most, with a fast and safe delivery service.
